extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: sternwheel paddle steamer (riverboat), stylized and shortened to approx. 34.9 x 8.6 x 19.2 m (L incl. wheel x W x H incl. funnels)
extras.notes: bow faces -Y; sits on its keel at z = 0, add your own water (waterline at 0.7 m: blue boot stripe above the antifouling); paddle-steamer_paddle_wheel is a separate object with origin on the axle (rotate around local X in Blender); opaque tinted windows, no interior; no name, no text, no flag, no brand

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
